query:
-- Total empleados, casos abiertos y cerrados
SELECT 'Total Empleados' as metrica, COUNT(*) as valor FROM users
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Casos Abiertos', COUNT(*) FROM cases WHERE status = 'open'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Casos Cerrados', COUNT(*) FROM cases WHERE status = 'closed'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total Casos', COUNT(*) FROM cases;
